summary: Backend-only verification of SQLite->MongoDB dual-storage migration for Trinity ticket-hygiene notifier. Ran full pytest suite and real MongoDB parity checks. All 110 tests pass. SQLite default behavior preserved. Real mongod parity confirmed: Store() returns MongoStore, Data() returns MongoData when MONGO_URL set; claim_alert is atomic (2nd claim on same (rule,trigger_event_id) returns False); record_alert does not create duplicate rows (count_alerts stays at 1). Test DB dropped afterwards.
critical_code_review_comments: Store() and Data() factories still require the SQLite path/db_path positional arg even when MongoDB is used — path is ignored in Mongo mode. Non-blocking but slightly misleading API; consider making the arg Optional and documenting it is ignored when MONGO_URL is set.
notifier/store.py is 338 lines and dashboard/queries.py exceeds the 700-line guideline target area — queries.py should be monitored for splitting as more features land; currently acceptable.
test_credentials: none required; tests use fakes and local mongod
seed_data_creation: none; parity check used ephemeral DB 'hygiene_verify' which was dropped
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest suite: 110 passed in ~5s. Named duplicate-alert tests pass on both SQLite (tests/test_service.py) and mongomock (tests/test_service_mongo.py). Real mongod parity verified at mongodb://localhost:27017 with DB_NAME=hygiene_verify: MongoStore/MongoData classes selected; claim_alert atomicity holds; record_alert is idempotent on (rule,trigger_event_id). JUnit XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml.
